answer_2.quote: We use Self-BLEU (Zhu et al., 2018) to measure the diversity of the generated counterfactual examples... We also calculate the dataset distance via OTDD... The Label Flip Rate (LFR) calculates the percentage of new examples that flip the original label to the target label.

answer_4.quote: We use Amazon Mechanical Turk to conduct human evaluations, asking annotators to label a random subset of our data... We assigned three annotators for each example and did majority voting on the annotated labels.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators label the new sentence pairs following the standard annotation process for the NLI task.
